**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

The audit regime in § 22 already sits at our preferred position:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Once per 12 months | § 22.1 "no more than once in any twelve-month period" |
| 30 days' written notice | § 22.1 "at least thirty days' prior written notice" |
| Business hours | § 22.1 "during normal business hours" |
| Independent auditor + confidentiality | § 22.1 "an independent auditor bound by confidentiality" |
| Off-site where possible | § 22.1 "conducted off-site where practicable" |
| Vendor cost unless underpayment > 5% | § 22.2 |
| No direct system access | § 22.2 "may not access Customer systems directly" |

Coverage check across the document: § 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") is a bare heading with no operative text, and no other provision (§§ 12, 13.4, 15, 17, 26.4) confers any Vendor inspection, verification, metering or remote-access right over us. § 22.3 adds further protection in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, shortfall payment resolves the audited quantity). Nothing here falls short of the fallback, so we should not reopen this clause.
